summary: Frontend-only test of the Phase 1 media and card redesign. I used a temporary /app/temp-qa route that rendered JourneyPostCard against mockUpdates u4/u10/u9/u2/u5/u3/u7/u11/u15/u13, plus synthetic TEST_ 2-image, mixed image+video and external-video posts. The route was deleted afterwards and the frontend rebuilt. I tested /explore by intercepting the broken live /api/feed/explore with Playwright page.route and serving mock FeedPost JSON. Widths tested: 1920, 768 and 390. Several things work: the media dispatch logic, the +N counts, the viewer navigation, inline video play, fullscreen expand, the sharper radii scoped to feed and explore, and every regression flow. However, there is 1 CRITICAL layout bug in MultiImageGrid. In every 3, 4, 5+ and mixed-media grid the tiles overflow their aspect-ratio container. Only the hero and the first supporting tile are visible, and the +N overlay is clipped away, so the user never sees it. There are also 3 other real bugs: the fullscreen viewer backdrop is transparent, Explore video cards show a broken image, and a purple leftover remains in Explore.

minor.issue: Still returns 500 'An internal server error occurred' (pre-existing and known, not part of this change)

ui_bugs.issue: Once the images load, the grid tiles grow to the images' natural height and overflow the aspect-[16/9] container, which is 338px tall at a 600px card width. Measured tile heights: 4-image hero 721px, supporting tiles 238px each; 6-image tiles 398px each with the last tile spanning 804-1203px; 3-image tiles 402/199/199px. overflow-hidden clips them, so only the hero and the top part of tile #1 are visible. Tiles 2 and 3 and the +1/+2 overlay are never visible, even though the DOM and logic are correct. This happens at 390, 768 and 1920 widths. 2-image grids are not affected. ROOT CAUSE: the in-flow inside the h-full Tile contributes its intrinsic size to the implicit auto grid row (grid-cols-5 / grid-rows-N with h-full wrappers). VERIFIED FIX (CSS injected in the browser): give the Tile img 'absolute inset-0' (the Tile is already 'relative'). The tiles then measured 358x338 for the hero and 238x110 for each of the 3 supporting tiles, which is correct. Adding 'min-h-0' and 'grid-rows-1' to the outer grid is an alternative or extra safeguard.

The class 'bg-[#0E0D0C]/92' is not generated by Tailwind 3.4, because 92 is not in the opacity scale. The computed background is rgba(0,0,0,0), so the theater view shows the light page behind a blur instead of a dark backdrop. Fix: use 'bg-[#0E0D0C]/[0.92]' or '/90'.

ui_bugs.component: ExploreView video cards (desktop card bannerUrl and mobile 'video' format imageUrl)
ui_bugs.issue: For video posts the card image src is post.media[0].url, which is the YouTube watch URL rather than an image. This gives a broken image: naturalWidth 0, alt text shown on mobile, black hero on desktop. Use media.thumbnail_url, falling back to getVideoPosterUrl() (the YouTube hqdefault image) from mediaHelpers. Seen in ExploreView.tsx lines 103-105 and 146-148.
A purple leftover is still present: the accent bar under the title uses bg-[#8B5CF6] (violet-500). It is visible on mobile under the 4-image and 6-image cards. Replace it with bg-gm-accent.

issues: Text-only posts still show a stock Unsplash hero image (bannerUrl fallback), which misrepresents the content. Consider a typography-first or solid hero for text-only posts, like the mobile 'white-minimal' format.
The in-card 'Follow +' and 'View Milestone' buttons are still rounded-full pills, even though the card shell itself is now 8px. This is inconsistent with the brief's 'sharper explore cards'.

Regression versus the old card: the journeyTag chip and the startDate→endDate chip now render only on text-only posts. Media posts lost them, whereas the old card showed them as e.g. 'Portrait moment' with dates.
Deleting your own post fires two toasts ('Update deleted' from AppContext and 'Journey moment deleted' from the card).
Un-saving a post still toasts 'Post saved to your bookmarks' (AppContext.toggleSave).
The Community Thread count falls back to a fake '24' when there are no comments. The drawer header also said '24 comments' while the card showed (2) and the drawer list was empty.
The 'Read more' toggle renders even when the caption is short and not clamped.
The ReportModal does not close on Escape.
Mock video 6BJF8SunNT4 (u2) shows 'Video unavailable' on YouTube. This is a mock data issue.

passed_checks: Card 12px radius. Media containers, grid wrappers and all action buttons (Fuel/Save/Passport/Follow/Community Thread) are 8px. There are no pills in feed cards.
Text-only (u4): serif headline, no media area, milestone chip.
Single landscape (u10): 600x338 (16/9). Single portrait (u9, u13): 380x475 (4/5), centered.

Single video (u2, u5): YOUTUBE badge, poster, centered Play. The Play button embeds the youtube-nocookie iframe inline and the viewer is not opened. The top-right expand button opens the viewer with an iframe.
External video link: the badge shows EXAMPLE.COM, and Play shows 'Preview unavailable' plus an 'Open original video' link.
Grid tile counts in the DOM: 2→2 tiles, 3→3, 4→4 with no +N, 5→4 tiles with +1 on the last, 6→4 tiles with +2 on the last (the logic is correct, only the visual clipping fails).
Mixed image+video: the video tile shows a play overlay, and clicking it opens the viewer ('2 of 3') with an embedded iframe. It never plays inline.

Viewer: tile 3 on a 6-image post opens at '4 of 6'. next/prev cycle with wrap-around, ArrowRight works, and Escape, the X button and a backdrop click all close it. A single image opens '1 of 1' with no chevrons.

Regression: Fuel toggles Fuel/Fueled and shows the toast. Save toggles Saved/Save (after seeding context). Follow/Following toggles with a toast, and there is no Follow button on your own post. The 3-dot menu offers Copy Link plus Report on others' posts, which opens ReportModal, and Copy Link plus Delete on your own post, which removes it. The author link goes to /profile/{username}, and Passport links to /passport/{username}. Read more/Show less toggles. The Community Thread bottom sheet opens with My Ask, the ask prompt and the Conversation section, and closes cleanly.

Explore (mocked API): the card radius is 8px on desktop and mobile. Desktop shows a Play badge on video and an image-count badge ('4', '6'). Mobile shows '1/4' and '1/6' badges. The mobile format is content-aware (text→white-minimal, video→video, images→tall-hero/top-image). The mobile video card shows a static Play plus a 'Video' chip, with no Pause or volume icons.
Non-feed UI is unchanged: the nav links, Edit Profile, QR Code and New Journey on /profile/you all compute border-radius 9999px. git diff confirms only the feed/explore files changed.
No horizontal overflow at 390 or 768 (scrollWidth equals clientWidth).
action_items: CRITICAL: MultiImageGrid Tile: change the to 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover' (optionally also add min-h-0 and grid-rows-1 to the outer grid) so the 3, 4, 5+ and mixed grids fit the aspect box and the +N overlay is visible.
FullscreenMediaViewer: change bg-[#0E0D0C]/92 to bg-[#0E0D0C]/[0.92] or /90 so the theater backdrop is actually dark.
ExploreView: for video media use thumbnail_url, falling back to getVideoPosterUrl(), for bannerUrl and imageUrl. Do not use the raw video URL as an src.
ExploreView line 455: replace bg-[#8B5CF6] with bg-gm-accent.

Optional: restore the journeyTag/date chips on media posts. Remove the duplicate delete toast. Make the unsave toast accurate. Drop the fake '24' comment fallback. Add data-testids to the Explore mobile and desktop cards.
critical_code_review_comments: Any Tailwind opacity modifier outside the default scale (e.g. /92) silently generates nothing in Tailwind 3.4. Use the arbitrary form /[0.92].

The FullscreenMediaViewer is rendered inside the <article> instead of a portal. It works now, but any future transform, filter or contain on the card or its ancestors (e.g. motion wrappers) will break position:fixed. Consider using createPortal.
The viewer does not lock body scroll while it is open.
ExploreView.tsx is about 1047 lines, which exceeds the 700-line guideline. Split the mobile card renderers into their own component.
Explore cards have no data-testid attributes, which makes them hard to test.

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Clicking resetDemoUser in the temp page loaded in-memory mock updates. Synthetic TEST_ posts existed only in the temp page and in Playwright route mocks. No backend writes happened (the backend is down).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The live backend /api/feed* returns 500. To test cards, recreate the app/temp-qa page (JourneyPostCard + mockUpdates + useApp().updates; resetDemoUser seeds the context so Save state works), then restart the frontend: it runs next build, roughly 3 minutes. For /explore, intercept **/growingmoonbackend.onrender.com/** with page.route and fulfill /api/feed/explore with {items:[FeedPost...],has_more:false} (see /app/tests/mock_feed.py for the shape). /home does not fetch the feed when /api/users/me fails, so it cannot be mocked the same way. To verify the grid fix, measure each [data-testid^=media-grid-tile-] rect against its .mt-4 container height after the images load. Mock data has no 2-image or mixed posts, so use synthetic ones.
rca of the issue: MultiImageGrid overflow: the outer aspect-ratio box has a definite height, but the inner grid uses an implicit 'auto' row (grid-cols-5 with no grid-template-rows) and the nested grid-rows-3 wrappers use h-full. A replaced with h-full contributes its natural height as the min-content contribution, so the auto row and the stacked tiles grow beyond 100%. overflow-hidden then clips the bottom tiles and the +N badge. Repro: open any 4/5/6-image post, wait for the images to load, and compare the tile getBoundingClientRect heights with the container (338px). Mitigation: absolutely position the img inside the relative Tile (verified in the browser), or add min-h-0 and explicit grid-rows-1.
